newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle sales thin at $114/dressed-feedlot.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle sales thin at $114/dressed-feedlot.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets Monday were slow, with about 300 head trading in a light test at $114.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, market sources there said.
But some bids at $114.00 were countered by asking levels ranging from $117.00 to $118.00.
On a live basis, there were a few bids at $72.00, with owners mostly asking $74.00.
Prices this week were seen supported by tighter finished cattle supplies, with this week's showlist estimated at 47,200 head, down 5,700 from last week, the sources said.
